name: Ceugant

attributes.attribute: the final and outermost circle of Llewelyn Sion's cosmogony

text: Ceugant marks the outermost ring of a Welsh cosmogony drawn as concentric circles. Llewelyn Sion set out this scheme in the sixteenth century. Beyond every created order sits Ceugant, the last circle. Infinity alone dwells there. The Welsh word carries the senses sure, true, and infinity, and some writers spell the name Ceugand.

okr.objective: Document Ceugant as the outermost circle of Llewelyn Sion's Welsh cosmogony.
key_results: Record its place as the last circle, beyond every created order.
Note that infinity alone dwells there.
Record the variant spelling Ceugand and the word's senses of sure, true, and infinity.
